comment: The expander check is on the left side only and is by model slug (RegexExp.cpp:27-30), so the module has to be directly right of Biset-Regex or Biset-Regex-Condensed. The outputs are given no family: in clock mode they are gates and in pitch mode they carry a pitch. The sign flip in pitch mode is in the source at RegexExp.cpp:44, where the Regex output is negated before being written; the maker's own summary describes this module as outputting gates, and says nothing about pitch at all.
